products.title: Limited Edition Art Print
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

Once a season we make something with no brief but our own.

THE DECISIONS

An original studio artwork, giclée-printed on cotton rag in an edition of fifty, each signed and numbered, sized to a standard frame so it's easy to live with.

DETAILS

  • Giclée on 310gsm cotton rag
  • A2
  • Edition of 50, signed and numbered
  • Unframed

products.title: The Maker's Gift Set
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The set we assemble for clients on launch day, opened up to everyone.

THE DECISIONS

Our cardholder, the studio mug and a numbered print, boxed in a cloth-wrapped case with a hand-finished closure — built to be given, not just bought.

DETAILS

  • Includes leather cardholder, studio mug, A4 numbered print
  • Cloth-wrapped rigid box
  • Ribbon closure

products.title: Heavyweight Studio Jacket
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The signature piece — what a year of making things for other people taught us to make for ourselves.

THE DECISIONS

A 480gsm brushed-back fleece cut like outerwear, a two-way zip, and a collar that stands without help. Made in a run of limited numbers.

DETAILS

  • 480gsm brushed-back cotton fleece
  • Two-way YKK zip
  • Structured collar, bound seams
  • Ink

products.title: Laneway Weekender Bag
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The piece that says what the studio can do when nothing's holding it back.

THE DECISIONS

A waxed-canvas body on a full leather base, brass hardware chosen to age rather than shine, and a separate shoe/wash compartment because we travel like this ourselves.

DETAILS

  • Waxed canvas, full-grain leather base
  • Brass hardware
  • End compartment
  • 40L, field tan

products.title: Laneway Leather Cardholder
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The first thing we ever made for ourselves — and still the test of whether we've earned the price.

THE DECISIONS

Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather cut to four pockets and a centre pull, edge-painted by hand and left unlined so it patinas with use.

DETAILS

  • Full-grain veg-tan leather
  • 4 pockets, centre pull
  • Hand-painted edges, unlined
  • Tan, ages darker

products.title: Laneway Canvas Tote
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

A studio tote takes a beating — laptops, samples, the market on Sunday.

THE DECISIONS

A heavyweight waxed canvas with a reinforced base and webbing handles rated past the usual tote, finished with a leather tab.

DETAILS

  • 16oz waxed canvas
  • Reinforced base
  • Webbing handles, leather tab
  • Charcoal

products.title: Laneway Mug
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

Every studio has the mug everyone fights over. We made enough of ours to go around.

THE DECISIONS

A heavy stoneware with an unglazed raw foot and a handle sized for a real grip, in a reactive glaze so no two are quite identical.

DETAILS

  • Stoneware, 400ml
  • Reactive glaze
  • Raw clay foot
  • Dishwasher safe

products.title: Laneway Insulated Bottle
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The studio runs on long blacks and longer days. The insulated bottle earns its desk space.

THE DECISIONS

A clean silhouette that slips into a bag, double-walled to hold heat (or cold) past the afternoon, and a screw-top lid that seals against spills.

DETAILS

  • Vacuum stainless, 500ml
  • Screw-top insulated lid
  • 12-hour heat retention, 24-hour cold retention
  • Graphite

products.title: Laneway Reusable Cup
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

We design these for clients constantly. This is the one we kept for ourselves.

THE DECISIONS

A ceramic-lined stainless body that doesn't taint the coffee, in a glaze-effect finish you'd not expect on metal.

DETAILS

  • Ceramic-lined stainless, 8oz
  • Press lid
  • Matte stone finish

products.title: Laneway Cap
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

A cap is the easiest thing to over-design. We wanted the opposite.

THE DECISIONS

An unstructured six-panel in washed cotton that creases in rather than sits stiff, with our mark embroidered tonally so it reads as texture, not logo.

DETAILS

  • Washed cotton, unstructured six-panel
  • Tonal embroidery
  • Adjustable strap
  • Ecru

products.title: Laneway Studio Crew
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

The jumper we kept borrowing from the sample rail. We finally made our own.

THE DECISIONS

A mid-weight loopback that holds shape without the gym-sweat bulk, set-in sleeves for a cleaner line, and a colour we mixed to sit between concrete and oat.

DETAILS

  • 340gsm cotton loopback
  • Set-in sleeve
  • Ribbed cuffs and hem
  • Stone

products.title: Laneway Studio Tee
products.body_html:
THE THINKING

We make things for other people all year. The Studio Tee was the brief we set ourselves: the blank we actually wanted to wear between projects.

THE DECISIONS

A heavier 220gsm so it hangs rather than clings, a longer body, and a collar reinforced to survive the wash that kills most tees. Branding lives on a tonal hem label.

DETAILS

  • 220 GSM combed cotton, garment-washed
  • Relaxed studio fit, longer body
  • Reinforced collar, tonal hem label
  • No front print

products.title: Southbank Coaster Set
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

A small thing for regulars to take the café ritual home.

WHAT WE DID

Pressed cork faced with the roastery's clay colourway, in a set of four banded with a paper sleeve rather than plastic.

DETAILS

  • Set of 4
  • Cork with printed face
  • Paper band, no plastic
  • 95mm

products.title: Southbank Notebook
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

For the roastery's own cupping notes — and the customers who started asking for one.

WHAT WE DID

A lay-flat bound book with a dot grid for tasting wheels, in a board cover the colour of a roasted bean.

DETAILS

  • A5, lay-flat binding
  • Dot-grid recycled paper
  • Espresso board cover

products.title: Southbank Tote
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

A bag for the bean run — sturdy enough for two 1kg bags and the weekend market.

WHAT WE DID

Heavy calico with a flat gusseted base so it stands on its own, and a discreet side print so it carries beyond the café.

DETAILS

  • 12oz calico
  • Gusseted base
  • Long shoulder handles
  • Natural

products.title: Southbank Mug
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

The cup for people drinking in — and the one regulars kept asking to buy.

WHAT WE DID

A thick-walled stoneware in a glaze we matched to the crema, weighty enough to feel like the café at home.

DETAILS

  • Stoneware, 350ml
  • Reactive crema glaze
  • Dishwasher safe

products.title: Southbank Pour-Over Dripper
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

Southbank wanted regulars to brew the roastery's filter range at home the way the café does — properly, not guessed.

WHAT WE DID

A ceramic cone dripper in the roastery's clay glaze, with a wide cone and tall internal ribs tuned for a slow, even extraction, and a flat base that sits on any mug or carafe.

DETAILS

  • Glazed stoneware cone dripper
  • Size 02 (1–4 cups)
  • Fits standard #2 filter papers
  • Clay glaze

products.title: Southbank Reusable Cup
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

Regulars wanted to carry the roastery with them, but most reusable cups either look like merch or don't work behind the machine.

WHAT WE DID

We sized it to sit cleanly under a standard group head and finished it in the roastery's clay and cream rather than a printed logo — the colour is the branding.

DETAILS

  • Double-walled, 8oz
  • Barista-standard group-head fit
  • Silicone band and splash lid
  • Clay and cream, no external print

products.title: Southbank Beanie
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

Something for the 6am openers and the regulars who linger.

WHAT WE DID

A fine-knit fold-up beanie with a woven tab rather than a print, so it works off the clock as easily as on.

DETAILS

  • Fine merino-blend knit
  • Fold cuff
  • Woven tab label
  • Oat and charcoal

products.title: Southbank Apron
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

An apron that reads as craft, not hospitality-supplier beige.

WHAT WE DID

Waxed-finish canvas in the roastery's clay tone, cross-back straps to save the neck over long shifts, and a chest pocket sized for a thermometer and cloth.

DETAILS

  • Cotton canvas, water-resistant finish
  • Adjustable cross-back straps
  • Single chest pocket
  • Clay

products.title: Southbank Barista Tee
products.body_html:
THE BRIEF

Southbank wanted floor staff to look like part of the roastery, not a uniform catalogue.

WHAT WE DID

We kept it to a single tonal chest mark in the roastery's espresso brown, on a heavyweight tee that survives a busy shift and a hot wash.

DETAILS

  • 220 GSM combed cotton
  • Relaxed fit
  • Tonal screen print
  • Espresso and oat

products.title: RMIT Badge
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

A small, cheerful finishing piece — brought in because the best ranges have something at pocket-money price.

DETAILS

  • Metal button badge, spring-pin back
  • Approx. 23mm diameter
  • Black or white with RMIT logo
  • Made in Australia

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “With a metal spring pin you can attach this RMIT button badge to your shirt, backpack or even your pencil case. Comes in black or white with the official RMIT logo, approx. 23mm diameter.”

products.title: RMIT A5 Recycled Notebook
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

A neat, sustainable notebook we added for the note-takers.

DETAILS

  • A5 (21.5 x 15.5 cm)
  • 100% recycled paper, FSC-certified
  • Brown kraft cover, spiral bound

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “Keep things compact and sustainable with the A5 Recycled Notebook. Crafted from 100% recycled paper, it's the perfect eco-conscious choice for capturing ideas on the go.”

products.title: RMIT Fairtrade Cotton Tote
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

An easy yes for the range — RMIT's Fairtrade tote, the bag that goes everywhere.

DETAILS

  • 100% organic Fairtrade cotton
  • Classic calico with navy RMIT logo
  • Twin shoulder handles
  • Ethically made in India

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “Our updated RMIT Cotton Tote Bag is a must-have essential — a versatile tote in classic calico with a navy RMIT University logo on front. Our Fairtrade products are 100% organic cotton, ethically sourced in India.”

products.title: RMIT Essential Mug
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

The desk mug, brought into the range for the studio and the home alike.

DETAILS

  • 330ml
  • Matte exterior with a colour pop inside
  • Dishwasher safe
  • Indigo, Red, Black

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “330ml capacity with a black matte finish and a pop of colour on the inside. Dishwasher safe.”

products.title: RMIT Everyday Bottle
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

The no-fuss everyday water bottle — RMIT's own, brought into Laneway as the simple, low-cost option for basic campus hydration.

DETAILS

  • 750ml
  • Leak-proof lid
  • Non-insulated, lightweight
  • Red, Blue, Black

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “A simple bottle that covers daily use without overcomplicating things. The 750 ml size carries enough water for long stretches on campus without constant refills.”

products.title: RMIT Everyday Reusable Cup
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

A reliable everyday cup we brought into Laneway — RMIT's made-by-Fressko reusable, built for the campus-to-café commute.

DETAILS

  • 340ml / 12oz
  • Double-walled vacuum stainless, BPA-free
  • Spill-proof, one-hand-open lid
  • Barista-friendly internal measure lines
  • Denim, Coal and Frost

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “Keeps your drink at temperature long enough to get through a lecture or commute without a second coffee run. The 340ml size fits standard café pours and the internal lines make it easy for baristas to use.”

products.title: RMIT Flex Fit Cap
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE

A clean campus cap we added for the days a tee needs a finish. RMIT-made, simply done.

DETAILS

  • 100% cotton
  • Flex-fit form
  • Lower-right logo with red accents
  • Beige

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…

From RMIT: “The RMIT Flex Fit Cap is made from 100% cotton, designed for both comfort and style. It features the 'RMIT University' logo on the bottom right, with red accents along the top.”

products.title: RMIT Essential Hoodie
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE
RMIT's everyday hoodie, brought into the range as the layer that does the most work — warm, plain, and easy to live in.

DETAILS
• Mid-weight fleece
• Centre-chest logo
• Drawstring hood, ribbed cuffs
• Navy
• Machine wash cold

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…
From RMIT: “A straightforward hoodie that keeps the RMIT branding front and centre without overcomplicating the design. The mid-weight fleece balances warmth and comfort across cold mornings and indoor spaces.”

products.title: RMIT Essential Tee
products.body_html:
IN THE RANGE
A wardrobe staple we were glad to bring into Laneway. RMIT's own everyday tee — here because a good range needs a dependable piece you reach for without thinking.

DETAILS
• 100% cotton
• Regular fit, ribbed crew neck
• Small left-chest logo
• Navy and White Marle
• Machine wash cold

WHAT OUR PARTNER SAYS…
From RMIT: “You get a clean way to show you're part of RMIT without it dominating your outfit. The 100% cotton keeps it breathable through long days moving between lectures and indoor spaces.”
